title: Giraffe dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='93' rx='30' ry='5' fill='#4A3B00' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Back leg (raised, dancing) -->
  <rect x='58' y='68' width='8' height='20' rx='3' fill='#E8A800'/>
  <rect x='60' y='84' width='10' height='6' rx='2' fill='#C48A00'/>
  <!-- Hoof -->
  <rect x='58' y='86' width='12' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8B6300'/>
  
  <!-- Front leg (standing) -->
  <rect x='32' y='65' width='8' height='22' rx='3' fill='#E8A800'/>
  <rect x='30' y='84' width='10' height='6' rx='2' fill='#C48A00'/>
  <!-- Hoof -->
  <rect x='30' y='86' width='12' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8B6300'/>
  
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='58' rx='20' ry='16' fill='#F5C400'/>
  <!-- Spots on body -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='52' r='3' fill='#B8860B'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='55' r='3.5' fill='#B8860B'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='62' r='2.5' fill='#B8860B'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='63' r='2' fill='#B8860B'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='60' r='2' fill='#B8860B'/>
  
  <!-- Neck -->
  <path d='M52 50 Q56 38 54 28 L46 26 Q44 38 42 50 Z' fill='#F5C400'/>
  <!-- Spots on neck -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='2.5' fill='#B8860B'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='34' r='2' fill='#B8860B'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='38' r='1.8' fill='#B8860B'/>
  
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='22' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#F5C400'/>
  <!-- Snout -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='26' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#FFDD55'/>
  <!-- Nose details -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='25' r='1.5' fill='#C48A00'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='27' r='1.5' fill='#C48A00'/>
  
  <!-- Ossicones (horns) -->
  <rect x='42' y='8' width='4' height='8' rx='2' fill='#C48A00'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='8' r='3' fill='#E8A800'/>
  <rect x='52' y='10' width='4' height='7' rx='2' fill='#C48A00'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='10' r='3' fill='#E8A800'/>
  
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='18' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#E8A800' transform='rotate(-30 38 18)'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='16' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#E8A800' transform='rotate(20 62 16)'/>
  
  <!-- Eye -->
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='20' rx='2.5' ry='3' fill='#5C3D00'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='19' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M56 28 Q59 31 62 28' stroke='#8B6300' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Raised front arm (dancing) -->
  <path d='M38 52 Q28 42 22 34' stroke='#E8A800' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <circle cx='21' cy='32' r='4' fill='#F5C400'/>
  
  <!-- Raised back arm (dancing) -->
  <path d='M58 50 Q68 40 74 30' stroke='#E8A800' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='28' r='4' fill='#F5C400'/>
  
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M30 56 Q20 50 18 44' stroke='#C48A00' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='17' cy='42' r='4' fill='#8B6300'/>
  
  <!-- Music notes (dancing vibe) -->
  <g fill='#FF6B6B'>
    <ellipse cx='18' cy='18' rx='3' ry='2.2' transform='rotate(-20 18 18)'/>
    <rect x='20' y='8' width='1.5' height='10' fill='#FF6B6B'/>
    <path d='M20 8 Q26 6 26 10' stroke='#FF6B6B' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#4ECDC4'>
    <ellipse cx='82' cy='48' rx='2.5' ry='1.8' transform='rotate(-20 82 48)'/>
    <rect x='83.5' y='40' width='1.2' height='8' fill='#4ECDC4'/>
    <path d='M83.5 40 Q88 38 88 42' stroke='#4ECDC4' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#FFE66D'>
    <ellipse cx='78' cy='62' rx='2.2' ry='1.6' transform='rotate(-20 78 62)'/>
    <rect x='79.5' y='55' width='1' height='7' fill='#FFE66D'/>
  </g>
</svg>
